description: Six voltages spread out from one input, each a whole multiple of the gap between that input and an offset. A Serge-style utility taken from the CGS CV Spread

inputs.text: The voltage the six outputs are spread around, marked INPUT A
The voltage the spread is measured against, marked OFFSET B; the six outputs step by the difference between INPUT A and this one

outputs.text: INPUT A plus three times the difference between INPUT A and OFFSET B
INPUT A plus twice the difference between INPUT A and OFFSET B
INPUT A plus the difference between INPUT A and OFFSET B
INPUT A minus three times the difference between INPUT A and OFFSET B
INPUT A minus twice the difference between INPUT A and OFFSET B
INPUT A minus the difference between INPUT A and OFFSET B
